name: LLM Log
description: Logs OpenClaw LLM inputs and outputs to a local JSONL file.

logFilePath.description: Path to the JSONL log file. Relative paths resolve from the OpenClaw state directory.

includeHistoryMessages.description: Whether to include full historyMessages in llm_input entries.

includeSystemPrompt.description: Whether to include systemPrompt in llm_input entries.

logFilePath.label: Log file path
logFilePath.help: JSONL file path for LLM request/response logs.

includeHistoryMessages.label: Include history
includeHistoryMessages.help: Log the full session history sent to the model.

includeSystemPrompt.label: Include system prompt
includeSystemPrompt.help: Log the resolved system prompt passed to the model.
